question: What permanent inbound frame limit should the QQBot gateway enforce: the proposed 1 MiB cap or a larger channel safety margin?
rationale: The code change correctly establishes a resource boundary, but choosing its value trades memory-exhaustion protection against the risk of rejecting valid gateway events; available contracts do not settle that tradeoff.

options.title: Raise the cap
options.body: Use a larger owner-approved margin, such as 16 MiB, to preserve strong bounding while reducing compatibility and message-loss risk.

options.title: Accept 1 MiB
options.body: Retain the proposed limit after a QQBot owner confirms that legitimate current and expected gateway envelopes cannot cross it.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Leave the `ws` default temporarily while gathering real QQBot event-size evidence sufficient to choose a permanent boundary.

recommendation.title: Raise the cap
recommendation.body: Use a larger owner-approved margin, such as 16 MiB, to preserve strong bounding while reducing compatibility and message-loss risk.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available feature-history signal ties the current QQBot gateway implementation to this contributor.
